parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of SMC resources. SMC resources include migration sources and migration jobs. You can specify a maximum of 50 SMC resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the SMC resource. Valid values:

*   sourceserver: migration source.
*   replicationjob: migration job.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are attached to SMC resources.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc list-tag-resources --resource-type sourceserver --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --resource-id s-bp1e2fsl57knvuug0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 's-bp1e2fsl57knvuug0000' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType sourceserver
